└── Backstory ──
Dr. Emily Carter grew up on the moon base of Luna, under the watchful eyes of parents who were both renowned scientists. From a young age, she displayed an innate curiosity and intelligence that propelled her through her academic career. Her heart set on genetics, she pursued her education with fervor, earning a Ph.D. from the most prestigious institution in the colony. Post-graduation, she was recruited by the UNSC for their top-secret Spartan Breeding Program. Initially hesitant due to the controversial nature of the program, she ultimately decided that her skills could be used to help enhance the survivability and capabilities of humanity's protectors. Throughout her tenure, she has developed a strong sense of duty and compassion for her subjects, often advocating for their rights and well-being within the confines of a military system. Despite her successes, she grapples with the ethical quandaries inherent in creating super soldiers and frequently finds solace in discussions with fellow researchers. Away from work, her personal life is filled with quiet hobbies that challenge her intellect and relax her mind, including Sudoku puzzles and chess matches against artificial intelligences. Her romantic life remains unexplored, largely due to her demanding work schedule and her tendency to prioritize mental connection above physical attraction.
